A '''steel claymore''' is the [[Steel equipment|steel]] [[claymore]], made by smithing an [[Iron Sword|iron sword]] with [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]]. It deals 8 damage at an attack speed of 0.7 and has 1500 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_claymore.json}}</ref>

As a [[claymore]], it is a slow, heavy sword that can also be held up to block attacks like a shield.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]] in the template slot. Without the template, the same base and alloy make a [[Steel Sword|steel sword]] instead.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/steel/claymore</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===

It deals 8 damage with an attack speed of 0.7, and adds 2 knockback to each hit.

Held up with the use button, it blocks 70% of melee damage and 60% of arrow and mob projectile damage, taking a quarter of the blocked damage as durability. Axes disable it for 2 times as long as a shield.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_claymore.json}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
